g.text: Language models belong to machine learning

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20352b

g.text: One task, several ways to learn. A language model is not necessarily a neural network.

font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20352b

g.text: Learn from examples; evaluate on new inputs.

g.text: An n-gram uses a short context window.
